fusions.name: Thundering Front
fusions.desc: Drives forward at a gallop, dealing 12 damage to everything in a cone 4 tiles ahead of you and knocking each back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Lance at Full Tilt
fusions.desc: A charging lance blow that deals 28 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 6% per 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 48%.

fusions.name: Full Gallop
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 40% for 8 seconds, with +8% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Gathered Stride
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover in pursuit, your physical damage rises 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
